entry.summaryHtml: Sweet pepper, dark chocolate, coffee, leather, wood and a flicker of citrus give the Primeros Escurio a compact but lively Brazilian character. The small handmade format should deliver a concentrated spicy-sweet smoke with enough body to avoid feeling like a thin mini. Coffee and dark cocoa linger behind the pepper on the finish.
